title: GK Media Studios - Videos
description:
Welcome to GK Media Studios, a Galway-based creative studio specialising in video production, podcasting, film development and digital storytelling.

We create cinematic, authentic content for businesses, broadcasters, cultural organisations, charities and communities across Ireland and Europe — capturing stories that matter, where people and place are always at the heart of the work.

Our channel features:
• Short films and documentaries
• Podcasts (audio & video)
• Behind-the-scenes content
• Community, culture & heritage stories
• Film & creative industry conversations

Based in Galway, Ireland, we’re proud to work from the West — collaborating with clients and creatives nationwide and internationally, while championing regional voices and local stories.

🎬 From concept to final delivery, we handle the full creative process — strategy, filming, editing, sound, and distribution.
